study.question: Does expressing action count/freshness evidence in the same disjoint match basis as the backbone pools improve its predictive use, and is any benefit specifically larger with continuous freshness than with count-derived presence?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: source inspection shows four exclusive backbone pools (neither/category-only/brand-only/both), but the correction summarizes overlapping all/category/brand/joint groups. A small correction network must recover exclusive action mass and conditional freshness through differences and count-weighted mean inversions after nonlinear log encoding. Direct exclusive summaries may reduce that burden. This is a parameterization/conditioning hypothesis about existing evidence, not new information. Trajectory review: static/pooled/DIN AUCs were 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861; count_freshness and match_groups reached 0.6186637742/0.6187998914. Naive grouped concatenation g0-r0006-groups_evidence reached 0.6185907798, below match_groups despite beating its redundant control, so evidence addition alone was insufficient. The residual g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness reached 0.6197365168 versus 0.6195402718 with presence, a small 0.000196245 freshness contrast; Logloss was slightly worse (0.195867346 versus 0.195862220). g0-r0008-conditioned_evidence beat additive_evidence by 0.000537696, but the redundant contrast was 0.000510317, leaving only 0.000027379 evidence-specific interaction. g0-r0009-rms_evidence reached 0.6200470321, only 0.000013592 above raw_evidence; normalization helped redundant inputs more, so reduced saturation did not establish an evidence-specific predictive mechanism. Latest joint-context replacement g0-r0010-joint_evidence lost 0.0006974985 AUC to pooled_evidence; joint_redundant lost 0.0007950030 to pooled_redundant. The interaction was slightly positive (+0.0000975045), but direct detailed performance worsened. Static context dependence was executed yet useful routing remains unsupported. The pooled detailed and redundant cells exactly reproduced the previous metrics at the same seed, not independent replication. Diagnostics on only the first 512 validation impressions show 85.15625% of histories at 128 events and sparse action/match cells (4.24414 occupied cumulative cells of 16); this motivates compact summaries but cannot establish population saturation. No unseen raw data or lifetime history is assumed. All results above are local observations or preliminary controlled contrasts, not repeated mechanism support.

nearest_work.difference: DIN describes target-conditioned learned weighted pooling and retaining interest intensity without softmax normalization. The local baseline uses adapted category/brand embeddings and normalized attention, so it is not exact DIN. This study instead retains deterministic exclusive means and tests a basis change in a separate count/freshness correction. Intensity, target conditioning, grouping and residual readouts are inherited/established ideas; no priority claim.

study.proposed_difference: Cross evidence_partition={exclusive,cumulative} with continuous_freshness={true,false}, retaining detailed counts in every cell. Cumulative groups are all/category/brand/joint; exclusive groups are neither/category-only/brand-only/both. Each group has four action cells. Both raw counts N and decayed sums D are computed directly in both bases in all variants; then selected counts become log1p(N)/log(129), and selected freshness is D/max(N,1) or 1[N>0]. Counts are capped only by the host visible history, not clamped by model selection. For each action, Nc=(e0+e1+e2+e3,e1+e3,e2+e3,e3), with the same mapping for D; the inverse is (N-C-B+J,C-J,B-J,J). Thus exact-arithmetic count/freshness information is unchanged: D=N*T. Direct reductions avoid numerical cancellation. Float rounding and exponential underflow remain limitations measured by diagnostic reconstruction errors. Keep pooled context after the unsuccessful joint-context trajectory. No new parameters or compute-saving claim. This is a locally new tested intervention relative to supplied sources; broad novelty is unverified. Registry paper searches for time and group returned no additional sources, not evidence of absence of prior work.
predictions: Let A(E,F), A(C,F), A(E,P), A(C,P) denote full-validation AUC for exclusive/cumulative with freshness/presence. Predict D_F=A(E,F)-A(C,F)>0 and F_E=A(E,F)-A(E,P)>0. For the stronger freshness-specific alignment hypothesis predict I=[A(E,F)-A(E,P)]-[A(C,F)-A(C,P)]>0. Report D_P separately rather than hiding a general count-basis benefit.

The cumulative_freshness cell should reproduce g0-r0009-rms_evidence / g0-r0010-pooled_evidence approximately under the same recipe. A material mismatch requires source/execution investigation before attributing a cross-round gain; within-suite contrasts remain primary.

Host diagnostics should show exact integer count-basis identities, exclusive cell sums equal backbone pool sizes, small decayed-sum/encoded reconstruction errors, freshness in [0,1], zero empty-cell values, finite [B] logits and zero correction for empty histories, with padding and reversal errors near floating-point tolerance.

No prediction of cheaper inference is made. Host measured full wall/GPU time, examples processed, parameters, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency determine cost. The first-512 head interaction and reconstruction metrics are code checks only.
falsifiers: D_F<=0 leaves useful exclusive reparameterization unsupported in this implementation. F_E<=0 leaves an incremental continuous-freshness claim unsupported. I<=0 leaves a freshness-specific alignment explanation unsupported even if overall AUC improves.

A gain only in presence cells supports a possible count/sparsity/conditioning effect, not a continuous-time explanation. A gain below the stronger frozen source or unstable across paired seeds is not grounds to replace the incumbent.

Incorrect count identities, nonfinite outputs, empty/padding failures or large reconstruction errors invalidate the intended matched-information comparison; diagnose and charge any failed host execution before scientific interpretation.
A single positive seed or an active multiplicative head is insufficient mechanism confirmation. No test/withheld feedback will be requested or incorporated.
alternative_explanations: An invertible information-equivalent change can still alter feature scale, sparsity, gradient conditioning and finite-width approximation. These are part of this reparameterization; positive results do not identify only semantic alignment.

Presence is determined by the retained detailed counts. It removes continuous age values from the correction slot, but the backbone still has inherited coarse age embeddings. This is not removal of all temporal information.

Training seed 42 is one paired initialization; checkpoint selection and repeated validation search can favor chance outcomes. First-512 diagnostics are candidate supplied and not population-level mechanism evidence.

Extra arithmetic is matched within this suite; end-to-end runtime, peak memory and throughput must be measured. The new cumulative cell is a mathematical replication, not guaranteed bitwise equivalence.
Exclusive cells change marginal occupancy and dynamic ranges and may simply provide a more useful count basis; the factorial distinguishes this from a freshness-specific effect only provisionally.

Hashed category/brand collisions and the undocumented as-of dates of static snapshots limit semantic and causal interpretations. Group alignment uses supplied buckets; no production point-in-time guarantee follows.

The frozen 128-event truncation and coarse action vocabulary can hide longer-term behavior. Absence of a gain would not refute complementarity with unavailable histories or different admissible parameterizations.
